Message.title: Message
Message.description: A chat message posted to a school channel or direct message thread

roomId.description: Channel identifier or direct message room key

sender.description: Profile information of the message author

content.description: Text body of the chat message

image.description: Optional attached camera photo data URL or image link

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was sent

reactions.description: Map of emoji characters to arrays of user IDs who reacted

seenBy.description: List of receipts indicating users who have seen the message

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile and status of an enrolled school student

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the student

role.description: Administrative authority role of the user

isMuted.description: Flag indicating if user is restricted from posting messages

isBanned.description: Flag indicating if user account is suspended from platform

lastSeen.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last activity

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: A school topic channel for group discussions

topic.description: Description and purpose of the channel

isLocked.description: Whether the channel is locked in read-only mode by staff

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Security record of an administrative or moderation action

action.description: Action type executed by the administrator

details.description: Descriptive summary of the action and target

/messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of chat messages across school channels and direct messages

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of student user profiles and status indicators

/channels/{channelId}.description: Predefined school channels available to all registered students

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Administrative records of moderation and management actions
